name: Aexaware Infotech MCP Server
description: Official Model Context Protocol (MCP) server for Aexaware Infotech. Exposes 7 tools for discovering engineering services, portfolio case studies, technical blog articles, verified contact info, sandbox API keys, simulated project inquiry estimation, and the OpenAPI specification.

tools.name: list_services
tools.description: Returns all 19 specialized engineering services offered by Aexaware Infotech with category, description, and tech stack.

category.description: Optional filter. One of: 'Web & Application Development', 'AI / ML & Data Science', 'Cloud & DevOps', 'Design & Marketing', 'Engagement Models'.

tools.name: list_portfolio
tools.description: Returns Aexaware portfolio case studies with project name, industry, tech stack, delivery timeline, and live URL.

tools.name: search_blog
tools.description: Keyword search across 21 Aexaware technical blog articles covering AI, cloud, DevOps, web, mobile, and security.

query.description: Search keyword or topic (e.g. 'docker security', 'LLM agents', 'React Native OTA').

tools.name: get_contact_info
tools.description: Returns verified contact details: email info@aexaware.com, phone +91 81407 34392, office address, and booking/project form links.

tools.name: provision_api_key
tools.description: Programmatically provisions a free sandbox API key. No credit card or sales form required. 10,000 req/month.

agent_name.description: Name of the requesting agent or app.

tools.name: submit_sandbox_inquiry
tools.description: Simulates submitting a project inquiry in safe test sandbox mode. Returns estimated delivery timeline, team size, and consultation URL without triggering real CRM notifications.

project_name.description: Title or summary of the proposed software project

timeline_weeks.description: Target delivery duration in weeks (typically 2-6 weeks for MVPs)

tech_stack.description: Array of preferred technologies or frameworks

tools.name: get_openapi_spec
tools.description: Returns the URL and summary of Aexaware's OpenAPI 3.1.0 specification with all defined paths.

resources.description: Token-efficient structured markdown overview for LLMs
Agent decision guidance and invocation instructions
Authentication, free tier, and API key provisioning guide
